name: yayaw-table-vue-chart
title: YaYaw Table Vue Chart
description: Optional chart display mode for YaYaw Table Vue (vertical and horizontal bars, line, area, bars and line, donut, funnel and number), rendered with Unovis as in shadcn-vue charts and an SVG funnel. Pass `chartRenderer` to `display-mode-renderers` and add "chart" to `table.displayModes`.
